name: JBM Auto Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1983, JBM Auto Ltd is in automotive business that manufactures and sells sheet metal components, tools, dies & moulds, and buses including sale of spare parts, accessories and maintenance contract for Buses[1]
keyPoints: Market Position:[1] JBM Auto is the flagship company of JBM Group, with operations across automotive components, tooling, electric buses, EV aggregates and electric mobility services. In FY26, it was India's largest electric bus manufacturer by unit sales, selling 1,282 buses for a ~24% market share. It has an e-bus manufacturing capacity of ~ 20,000 buses per annum.
pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 35.5% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Stock is trading at 6.97 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Debtor days have increased from 82.4 to 131 days.

announcements.text: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release 4 Nov - JBM EV launched ECOLIFE e12 bus in Singapore and set up APAC headquarters.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release 26 Oct - JBM Auto Q2FY27 PAT rose 12.46% to Rs 58.76 crore; revenue up 21.06%, EV fleet crossed 4,000 buses.

Financial Results (Standalone And Consolidated) As On 30Th September, 2026. 26 Oct - Board approved Q2/H1 FY27 unaudited results on 26 Oct 2026; consolidated revenue Rs 3,098.82 crore, PBT Rs 134.20 crore.

Board Meeting Outcome for Board Meeting Outcome For The Financial Results (Standalone And Consolidated) For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30Th September, 2026. 26 Oct - Board approved unaudited standalone and consolidated Q2/H1 FY27 results on 26 Oct 2026.
